levels.surface: أبو عبد الله جعفر بن عبد الله المحمدي

notes: «قال: دخلت على أبي جعفر الباقر» is a first-person narrative in which the Imam speaks and acts inside the scene; the Imam is not written as a link (rule 11: source or only in the scene?)
«أبيه» is a bare relation: the father of محمد بن منصور, who tells the scene in the first person
